answer: Use signal triangulation against Sybils: an identity earns trust only when independent observers in different regions confirm the same signal it broadcasts, so one operator cannot fake presence everywhere at once. Each confirmation becomes a glacier-slow credit, earned only through sustained contributions over weeks, never a burst of activity. A voyage of participation — answering, reviewing, helping — earns credits one at a time, and any clash between claimed location and observed signals voids them. Cloning multiplies cost without trust, while one honest participant gains full standing.
